item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
• Google sign-in built in
  • Company directory, your Google contacts and groups in People and Compose
  • Book meeting rooms from the event editor
  • Dock unread badge and new-mail banners: mail is checked every minute
  • Google Calendar events load again; the first sync waits out Gmail's per-minute limits
  • The module picker stays put when switching modules
  • Signed with Developer ID and notarized

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
• Updates itself: Remedio Mail now checks for new versions daily and installs them when you quit (or Remedio Mail → Check for Updates…).
  • Google Calendar inside the app: edit, create and delete events, Accept / Tentative / Decline invitations, Google Meet links.
  • Meeting reminders with a Join button (Settings → Calendar).
  • Work account offered automatically on Macs with Microsoft Entra Platform SSO.
